name: flow-mcp
description: Build, run, publish Eureka Flow visual workflows and manage credits from Claude — no code.
long_description: Eureka Flow MCP server. Lets Claude (and other MCP clients) create visual workflows, run them, publish them publicly, and manage billing credits at flow.eureka.codes / billing.eureka.codes — all in natural language. No key to copy: leave the API key blank and just say "log in" — the assistant opens a browser for Google sign-in and provisions a key. One key unlocks both flows and credits.

api_key.title: Eureka API Key (optional)
api_key.description: Optional — leave this blank and just say "log in" in chat: the assistant opens a browser for Google sign-in and provisions a key for you. Or paste an existing key from https://flow.eureka.codes → sign in with Google → Create Key → Copy (looks like "ec-..."). Unlocks both flows and credits.

tools.name: flow_read
tools.description: Read flows: list, load, export, graph; inspect nodes, ports, blocks, run history (read-only)

tools.name: flow_do
tools.description: Edit & run flows: create, update, publish, save, clone, run; node + edge changes

tools.name: credit_read
tools.description: Read credits: balance, purchasable packs, history (read-only)

tools.name: credit_do
tools.description: Purchase credits: top up with the card on file

tools.name: auth
tools.description: Sign in / out: browser-based Google login that provisions and stores an API key
